requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Syntactic ambiguity resolved via Business Rule BR-01. Concern-mixing detected (functional action + quality criterion). Decomposed into one functional requirement (sequence of actions) and one quality requirement (response time).

source_fragments: The user enters the access card with the access code.

fields.condition: the user inserts the access card into the card reader and enters the access code on the keypad
fields.object: the access card and access code

structured_requirements.final_statement: The user shall insert the access card into the card reader and enter the access code on the keypad.
structuring_notes: Resolved syntactic ambiguity 'enters the access card with the access code' to distinct sequential actions per BR-01.
Extracted functional sequence from concern-mixed requirement.

fields.condition: after user inserts card and enters code

structured_requirements.final_statement: The access control system shall respond within 500 milliseconds after the user enters the access code.
structuring_notes: Extracted quality criterion (response time) as a separate artefact per Pohl §25.2.
